changelog:
Take your own notes during a meeting.

While recording, type in the "Add a note" box - each note is stamped with its time in the meeting, saved with it, synced to your desktop, and used in the summary. Long-press a note to remove it. If the app is closed mid-meeting, your notes come back with the recovered recording.

Also new since 0.0.108: note categories, notes sync both ways with your desktop, and you can share a meeting transcript or select its text.
